processing.resampling: native QA first, GDAL area-weighted clear reflectance, support threshold, common complete spectrum
processing.nir: Sentinel-2 B8A / Landsat OLI B05; broad B08 never substituted
processing.cache: Prepared AOI/scene cache; immutable source assumption. Use refresh=True after upstream asset revisions.

acquisition.basis: AOI cell-date support, including permitted linear estimates
acquisition.selection: Initial date/footprint strata, then missing-date proximity weighted by scene cloud cover
acquisition.limitation: Bounded discovered candidates; unread-source benefit is a metadata heuristic, not known pixel-clear coverage or an optimal plan

display.method: Nearest-neighbor Web Mercator display reprojection; inspect original analysis cells

report.sampling: Projected common grid; QA applied on native grids before area averaging. Bands matched by sensor. Output pixels are masked below the clear-support threshold.
limitations: Bandpass adjustment on ordinary SR is partial harmonization; no BRDF normalization or common atmospheric reprocessing.
Daily mosaics represent a UTC day, not a simultaneous multi-sensor exposure.
Interpolation is allowed only between clear observations within max_gap_days, can smear change, and never extrapolates.
Search limits/truncation are retained; these scenes do not guarantee complete temporal or AOI coverage.
coverage_notes: Coverage goal 95% was not met: 87.0% supported. All planned candidates within the scene budget were prepared; missing data remain explicit.

checks: area CSV exact values and area balance
